mapper.select: SELECT JD.JOB_NAME AS JOB_NAME, JD.JOB_GROUP AS JOB_GROUP, JD.JOB_CLASS_NAME AS JOB_CLASS_NAME, JD.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, JD.IS_DURABLE AS IS_DURABLE, JD.JOB_DATA AS JOB_DATA, TR.TRIGGER_NAME AS TRIGGER_NAME, TR.TRIGGER_GROUP AS TRIGGER_GROUP, TR.TRIGGER_STATE AS TRIGGER_STATE, TR.TRIGGER_TYPE AS TRIGGER_TYPE, TR.START_TIME AS START_TIME, TR.END_TIME AS END_TIME, TR.NEXT_FIRE_TIME AS NEXT_FIRE_TIME, TR.PREV_FIRE_TIME AS PREV_FIRE_TIME, TR.MISFIRE_INSTR AS MISFIRE_INSTR, TR.PRIORITY AS PRIORITY, CT.CRON_EXPRESSION AS CRON_EXPRESSION, CT.TIME_ZONE_ID AS TIME_ZONE_ID, ST.REPEAT_COUNT AS REPEAT_COUNT, ST.REPEAT_INTERVAL AS REPEAT_INTERVAL, ST.TIMES_TRIGGERED AS TIMES_TRIGGERED FROM QRTZ_JOB_DETAILS JD LEFT JOIN QRTZ_TRIGGERS TR ON JD.JOB_NAME = TR.JOB_NAME AND JD.JOB_GROUP = TR.JOB_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_CRON_TRIGGERS CT ON TR.TRIGGER_NAME = CT.TRIGGER_NAME AND TR.TRIGGER_GROUP = CT.TRIGGER_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_SIMPLE_TRIGGERS ST ON TR.TRIGGER_NAME = ST.TRIGGER_NAME AND TR.TRIGGER_GROUP = ST.TRIGGER_GROUP ORDER BY JD.JOB_GROUP, JD.JOB_NAME

SELECT JD.JOB_NAME AS JOB_NAME, JD.JOB_GROUP AS JOB_GROUP, JD.JOB_CLASS_NAME AS JOB_CLASS_NAME, JD.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, JD.IS_DURABLE AS IS_DURABLE, JD.JOB_DATA AS JOB_DATA, TR.TRIGGER_NAME AS TRIGGER_NAME, TR.TRIGGER_GROUP AS TRIGGER_GROUP, TR.TRIGGER_STATE AS TRIGGER_STATE, TR.TRIGGER_TYPE AS TRIGGER_TYPE, TR.START_TIME AS START_TIME, TR.END_TIME AS END_TIME, TR.NEXT_FIRE_TIME AS NEXT_FIRE_TIME, TR.PREV_FIRE_TIME AS PREV_FIRE_TIME, TR.MISFIRE_INSTR AS MISFIRE_INSTR, TR.PRIORITY AS PRIORITY, CT.CRON_EXPRESSION AS CRON_EXPRESSION, CT.TIME_ZONE_ID AS TIME_ZONE_ID, ST.REPEAT_COUNT AS REPEAT_COUNT, ST.REPEAT_INTERVAL AS REPEAT_INTERVAL, ST.TIMES_TRIGGERED AS TIMES_TRIGGERED FROM QRTZ_JOB_DETAILS JD LEFT JOIN QRTZ_TRIGGERS TR ON JD.JOB_NAME = TR.JOB_NAME AND JD.JOB_GROUP = TR.JOB_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_CRON_TRIGGERS CT ON TR.TRIGGER_NAME = CT.TRIGGER_NAME AND TR.TRIGGER_GROUP = CT.TRIGGER_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_SIMPLE_TRIGGERS ST ON TR.TRIGGER_NAME = ST.TRIGGER_NAME AND TR.TRIGGER_GROUP = ST.TRIGGER_GROUP WHERE JD.JOB_NAME = #{jobName} AND JD.JOB_GROUP = #{jobGroup}
